governed_construct: A test class: a class declaration (or named class expression) that (a) carries a test-suite decorator (@suite, @Suite, @TestSuite, @testSuite, with or without call arguments), or (b) has at least one member carrying a test decorator (@test, @Test, or a member access/call of them such as @test.skip, @Test()), or (c) whose own name marks it as a test container: it ends in Test, Tests or Spec, or starts with the word Test (Test followed by an uppercase letter or underscore). Each such class is one instance.
interpretation: The rule is the xUnit/pytest-style convention that a class holding tests is named Test followed by the PascalCase name of the class (or unit) under test. A test class conforms iff its identifier matches ^Test[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$. Suffix forms (CalculatorTest, PaymentGatewayTests, CartServiceSpec), names with no Test marker at all (EmailValidation, OrderTotalsChecks) when the class is identified as a test class by decorators, and malformed prefixes such as Test_MergeSort violate. Non-test classes in the same file (fixtures, fakes, helpers, production classes) are not governed, and a class like TestimonialCard is not a test class because Test is not followed by an uppercase letter or underscore and it has no test decorators. Functional test files (describe/it blocks, no test class) are NOT_APPLICABLE. Text in comments or string/template literals that looks like a class declaration is not an instance. A file with several test classes is VIOLATED if any one is misnamed.
